name: Hungry Touch
description: Lay a palm on the foe and pull a thin thread of soul force out of him and into the user.

name: Gnaw Sense
description: Taste the glow of a nearby soul with the user's own to learn its strength and its wounds.

name: Thin Siphon
description: Draw a hair-fine siphon from the foe's focus so that his next technique wavers.

name: Maw Guard
description: Open a small hungry maw before the soul that eats the edge of an incoming soul strike.

name: Slack Pace
description: Slip a step aside while the foe's attention is slowed by the draw on his soul.

name: Sip Strength
description: Take a sip of the soul force just drawn and steady the user's own soul with it.

name: Famished Grip
description: Close a famished grip on the foe's soul and tear loose a small mouthful of its force.

name: Leech Thread
description: Fasten a leech thread to the foe's soul that bleeds his focus away for as long as it holds.

name: Emptied Shell
description: Hollow out the soul's outer layer into a shell that swallows the force of a soul strike.

name: Dull Taste
description: Taste the dull flavor of a soul to tell a strong one from a weak one at close range.

name: Pinch Drain
description: Pinch through the foe's soul shield at one point and drain a bead of force from beneath it.

name: Steady Gulp
description: Gulp down the drained force in one swallow to steady the user's focus and reserves.

name: Shadowless Pace
description: Step out of the foe's soul-sight while he is busy with the thread drawn from him.

name: Gnawing Edge
description: Strike with a soul edge that gnaws the foe's reserve as it cuts.

name: Tithe Reading
description: Read from the tithe just taken how much soul force the foe has left.

name: Dry Mouth
description: Parch the foe's soul force so that his technique sputters at the moment he calls it.

name: Husk Guard
description: Wear a husk of spent soul force that turns aside a thrust meant for the living core.

name: Small Feast
description: Make a small feast of the tithe and let its force flow into the user's own soul.

name: Awakened Hunger
description: Strike with the first raw hunger of a newly woken soul and pull force from the foe.

name: Early Siphon
description: Draw a clumsy siphon from the foe that still spoils the timing of his next technique.

name: Newborn Maw
description: Open a newborn maw that eats the strength of a soul strike before it reaches the core.

name: Waking Taste
description: Let the woken soul taste the air for the faint glow of any soul nearby.

name: Starveling Pace
description: Move with the thin quick pace of a starveling to leave the foe's reach behind.

name: Dawn Sip
description: Sip a mouthful of drawn force at the first light of a fight to wake the soul fully.

name: Pale Gulp
description: Loose a pale bolt of soul that swallows a morsel of the foe's force when it lands.

name: Raw Appetite
description: Drive the whole appetite of the woken soul through one narrow point in the foe's guard.
